conventions.inventory_authority: This inventory is the authored authority. documentation and migration fields are authoring-only and never create AV predicates or classes.
conventions.ranges: IRI is absolute; av:Class is a node of that class; enum names denote listed controlled IRIs; integer is exact xsd:integer; json is an opaque rdf:JSON literal.
conventions.cardinality: min/max are per-use RDF cardinalities. null max is unbounded. Concrete JSON documents additionally require complete records, arrays for set fields, unique names and condition checks.
conventions.numbers: Input integer facts use safe JSON integer tokens (magnitude at most 9007199254740991) or explicit full-xsd:integer typed decimal lexical values. Normalized descriptors use exact mathematical integer values; implementations must preserve their precision. No float, boolean or numeric-string coercion. Rational denominator is positive and pairs are gcd-reduced.
conventions.collections: Offers, Modes, Tracks and inputs are unordered sets serialized as arrays. Native Form arrays are not priorities. Track names are unique and normalized by ascending Unicode code-point order.
conventions.absence: Essential missing representation fields invalidate a concrete Mode. Other absent facts are unknown. presence and accepts are required; Optional only permits not selecting the entire input.
conventions.authority: ONVIF/GenICam/UVC/native application mechanisms own controls and operation behavior. No camera-control, trigger, lease, fence, clock, resource, provenance or controller-framework prerequisites.

MediaKind.Live: Open-ended live media. No zero duration, recording extent or delivered-continuity guarantee.
MediaKind.Still: One image-shaped item; reading it does not imply a new exposure. Cadence and frameRate are absent.
MediaKind.Clip: The whole finite media item. Native media/container or explicit native interactions own extent and selection; no AV timeline/selector prerequisite.

Representation.EncodedVideo: Codec-encoded video/image data, distinct from decoded pixels.
Representation.RawVideo: Unencoded image pixels with a fixed format and memory layout.
Representation.EncodedAudio: Codec-encoded audio, distinct from decoded samples.
Representation.PCM: Uncompressed audio samples with explicit sample and buffer formats.

Codec.H264: ITU-T H.264/AVC encoded-video family. Native bitstream and negotiation own decoder initialization, profile and level; no decoder-support claim.
Codec.JPEG: JPEG-coded image family. The actual coding variant and decoding remain native; not raw RGB/BGR pixels.
Codec.AAC: AAC encoded-audio family. Native configuration owns object type, initialization and transport parameters; no decoder-support claim.
Codec.H265: ITU-T H.265 / ISO/IEC 23008-2 HEVC encoded-video family. Native bitstream and negotiation own profile, tier, level and initialization; not H264, a container or a WebRTC support claim.
Codec.Opus: IETF RFC 6716 Opus encoded-audio family. Native configuration and negotiation own framing and transport; not PCM or a guarantee of sample rate, channels or decoder support.

PixelFormat.BGR8: uint8 B,G,R component order; HWC logical geometry; three bytes per pixel.
PixelFormat.RGB8: uint8 R,G,B component order; HWC logical geometry; three bytes per pixel.
PixelFormat.Mono8: One uint8 intensity component per pixel.
PixelFormat.YUV420P: 8-bit planar Y then U then V, 4:2:0 sampling; exact colorimetry and strides remain native interface facts.

Cadence.Constant: Exact constant media cadence, requiring frameRate.
Cadence.Variable: Variable media cadence; no exact frameRate is implied.
Cadence.Triggered: Event/trigger-determined cadence, not a constant rate.

ChannelLayout.StereoLR: Two ordered audio channels: left, then right.

BufferLayout.Contiguous: Packed raw image rows have no inter-row gaps; actual plane layout follows pixel format and native interface.
BufferLayout.Strided: Raw image rows or planes use strides. Actual stride values, offsets and memory accessibility remain native and are not implied here.
BufferLayout.Interleaved: PCM audio channel samples alternate within each sample frame.
BufferLayout.Planar: PCM audio channels occupy separate sample planes.

Presence.Required: This whole named input must be selected and satisfy its entire accepts schema; no execution is implied.
Presence.Optional: The whole input may be left unselected. If selected, every condition of its accepts schema remains hard.

matching_rules.target: One complete Mode, never combined facts or tracks from several Modes or named graphs.
matching_rules.track_identity: Include dcterms:identifier and known representation facts; omit @context, @id, @type, Form, security and backend-private fields.
matching_rules.controls: Only known exact 0.2 AV controlled IRIs normalize to av:Token. No local-name matching across namespaces.
matching_rules.schema_dialect_omission: An omitted $schema selects JSON Schema 2020-12 for this draft; every explicit $schema must identify exactly that supported dialect.
matching_rules.schema_scope: accepts is an object carried with @type @json. Only local self-contained references; never automatic external retrieval. Standard JSON Schema keywords only; unsupported vocabularies/keywords fail explicitly.
matching_rules.presence: Hard facts need standard required keywords. properties alone does not require presence. Schema default is annotation-only and never fills facts.
matching_rules.formats: format is annotation-only; this matcher deliberately does not enable automatic format assertions.
matching_rules.ordering: Track order has no semantic meaning; use contains/items/set-wide tests. Positional prefixItems schemas are explicitly unsupported by this portable matcher.
matching_rules.rational: Exact positive reduced av:numerator/av:denominator pairs support const/enum; no general rational inequalities, cross-field arithmetic guarantee or rounded FPS.
matching_rules.boundary: Metadata compatibility is not authorization, availability, decoder/layout/transport qualification or runtime acceptance.
matching_rules.conversion: JPEG cannot satisfy BGR8 directly. An explicitly exposed interoperable processor output can advertise BGR8 separately; internal cv2 operations need no separate Thing.

native_form_rules.identity: Offer document resolves to a TD whose id equals source. Mode form and every FormReference form identify exactly one native Form by absolute @id, never href, array position or copied endpoint.
native_form_rules.reference: FormReference document, form and native standard operation IRI are required. TD retrieval location and effective retrieval base are explicit; Thing id is not a document locator.
native_form_rules.native: Apply TD base resolution, native operation defaults and Form-over-Thing security inheritance. Unknown/unsupported native semantics fail explicitly; no silent fallback.
native_form_rules.result: Property DataSchema, Action output or Event data owns the result schema. A missing schema is unknown, not arbitrary-output compatibility.
native_form_rules.destination: Writable-property or Action input owns sink payload semantics. A requested destination requires result and separately supported native routing; metadata does not execute it.
native_form_rules.access: This offline resolver does not authenticate, invoke native operations, expand URI templates or implement SOAP/RTSP.
